# SmolLM 2
![Huggingface Logo](https://github.com/docker/model-cards/raw/refs/heads/main/logos/hugginfface-120x-hub@2x.svg)

Tiny LLM family built for speed, edge devices, and local development.

---

## Overview
An **OCI model artifact** for the SmolLM2 Instruct family (135M · 360M · 1.7B), packaged as **Safetensors** with a **vLLM-oriented layout/config** for convenient distribution via Docker Hub.

## Contents
- Model weights (`*.safetensors`)
- Associated configuration files (vLLM layout)

## Notes
- **DMR support:** Docker Model Runner **does not yet support safetensors**; **support is planned soon**.
- `*-vllm images`: These are provided today to support vLLM-compatible safetensor models. Their long-term role is still under discussion — options include continuing them as-is or exploring **OCI index–based distribution** (to offer `--platform`-like behavior). The approach may evolve depending on distribution standards and framework compatibility, with the goal of keeping things practical and developer-friendly.

## Sources:
- https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct
- https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-360M-Instruct
- https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct
